notes: The on-screen panel now actually arrives with the update. The object was reloading before the layout had finished being written.
Fixed updating itself: a release with an on-screen panel stopped halfway with an error and left the panel on the old layout.
The counter is now an on-screen panel as well as buttons on the object. Either one changes the total and both show it.
The panel header shows the running version, so an update is visible without opening the script.
An XML UI is now updated together with the script: both arrive as one update, or neither does.
Updates only when the host types !update in chat. Nothing is checked, downloaded or changed until somebody asks.
An update says in chat what changed, including anything from releases this copy skipped.
Several copies of the tool on one table post that between them once, instead of one identical message each.
It posts what changed, or that the tool is already current, or that the repository could not be reached.
Update checks are staggered, so many copies on one table no longer all fire at once.
